name: seo-topic-cluster
summary: Turn keyword, SERP-intent, and content-audit evidence into topic clusters, hub/spoke architecture, page roles, boundaries, and internal-link recommendations.
inputs: audience, offer, business goal, and conversion path
approved keyword, SERP-intent, and content-audit artifacts
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: approved current SERP or ranking-page evidence
approved DataForSEO or SE Ranking data
approval_gates: external_read: ask before current SERP, ranking-page, or provider reads not already covered by approved source artifacts
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
external_mutation: CMS, repository, code, link implementation, publishing, production, and provider configuration changes are out of scope
done_when: scope, domain, audience, offer, market, language, device, goal, and date are explicit
input artifacts and source status are recorded
clusters use user need, intent, business relationship, and page role
page roles and hub/spoke relationships have evidence-backed rationale
semantic similarity is not presented as proof of cannibalization
existing/new/refresh decisions and internal-link recommendations are explicit
new-page and refresh handoffs preserve SEO and Writing ownership
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify missing input artifacts are not replaced with fabricated evidence
verify clusters are not based solely on lexical similarity or embeddings
verify no page-count growth recommendation lacks a user/business rationale
verify no final copy, metadata prose, CMS, code, link, publishing, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
